study.question: Observed: recent_occupied click AUC 0.6624553103422315 exceeds equal_occupied 0.6605188821416846 by 0.0019364282005469. The corresponding dense gap is 0.0020314788083013; removing empty slots changes the gap by only -0.0000950506077544 in this seed. Dense replays reproduce g2-r0010, not independent evidence. Is this residual advantage due to higher resolution for recent event CONTENT, conditional on feedback timing, rather than a generic nonuniform averaging effect? The earlier early10 comparison changed both padding and stratum counts and did not identify this distinction.
study.hypothesis: If fine resolution near the end retains consequential recent item/action content, reversing event vectors separately inside valid auxiliary-union and valid complement strata should hurt recent-width compression more than equal-width compression. This preserves the complete visible event multiset and every per-summary count within each partition. The current study is diagnostic attribution of an inherited mechanism, with no new model-performance or originality claim.

study.proposed_difference: Add content_order=chronological|stratum_reverse to the inherited occupied model. For each sample, build sorted position lookups for valid auxiliary-union and valid complement strata. Map rank r to r (identity) or n-1-r (reverse) within its own stratum; leave padded positions fixed. The mapping is an involution. Gather the original assignment matrix columns by this mapping before bmm, routing complete original item/action values without copying Bx100xvalue_width. Masks are unchanged; every one of the thirty counts and active-row identities is exactly unchanged within a partition. Both orders execute the same rank lookup, sort and assignment-gather operations, with no RNG or trainable additions. Four standalone modules form a partition x content-order factorial. candidate.py registers the inherited chronological recent model for explicit comparison; that cell is an implementation replay, not a new architecture. The reversed recent model is also registered as a candidate alternative to allow evidence in either direction.
predictions: Define Rf,Rr,Ef,Er as click AUC for recent_forward, recent_reverse, equal_forward, equal_reverse. Predeclare interaction I=(Rf-Ef)-(Rr-Er)=(Rf-Rr)-(Ef-Er). Content-recency hypothesis predicts Rf>Rr and I>0. A difference or interaction >=0.0005 is a prospective practical-interest threshold, not a statistical significance test; require paired repetitions before controlled support is upgraded to repeated support.

Chronological recent/equal cells should reproduce g2-r0011-recent_occupied/equal_occupied validation predictions and initialized state within host numerical tolerance. Common permutation overhead can change measured cost. If replay discrepancies exceed expected reduction/dtype tolerance, diagnose and retain costs before interpreting the factorial.

Per-sample event multisets, valid and union-stratum masks, all thirty counts, occupied-score row counts, parameter keys/values and RNG state match within partition across orders. In a one-stratum full 100-event history, equal-width reversal merely permutes blocks and should preserve evaluation predictions within reduction tolerance at identical weights. Empty histories must be invariant at identical weights.

Predeclare primary population and history bins 0,1-16,17-64,>64. Report sample/positive/negative counts, all four task AUC/Logloss, auxiliary mean AUC separately, parameters, wall and allocated GPU seconds, examples, peak memory, throughput and model-only whole-batch p50/p95 latency. Same-weights empty-history invariance does not imply equal empty-history performance after different training trajectories.
falsifiers: If I is nonpositive, or reversing recent content does not reduce Rf materially, recent-content retention is not supported by this implementation. Similar recent advantages under both orders favor generic nonuniform averaging or feedback-schedule explanations.

If the reversed recent candidate improves click AUC, retain that result and revise the recency explanation; do not rename it evidence for the original direction. It may indicate smoothing, noisy recent content, or optimization rather than superior long-term preference modeling.

Any mask/count/permutation failure, changed initial parameter state, unintended source-gradient flow, label leakage or failure of identity replay invalidates mechanism interpretation and must be corrected before host training.
A single positive factorial interaction is preliminary and cannot establish a general mechanism, cross-seed reliability, original novelty or production validity.
alternative_explanations: Reversal changes summary values and hence Dice input distributions, even with identical counts and active-row identities. This is a content intervention, not a normalization-free experiment.
The auxiliary-union occurrence schedule is intentionally fixed, so this tests event-content recency conditional on that schedule; it cannot refute all forms of temporal relevance.
Recent versus equal widths change counts and average variance; only chronological versus reversed comparisons WITHIN a partition exactly match every count.
Equal-width reversal is not generally an exact null for partially filled blocks or mixed strata. Four-cell interaction is more informative than either single difference.
One fixed seed and one training pass confound mechanism estimates with optimization dynamics; same-seed replays are not independent repetitions.

Review of other trajectories: g2-r0000-match20 0.65725795 did not beat rotated20 0.65751609 or uniform20 0.65746867; semantic grouping alone was unsupported there. g2-r0009-target10 0.65983966 did not beat history10 0.66005224; target-conditioned routing was not supported there. These do not universally refute conditioning in another architecture.

g2-r0005-private_residual recovered auxiliary AUC to roughly 0.828/0.852/0.849 but click 0.66009916 trailed its 0.66064694 parent and cost increased to 435s. g2-r0008-encode_pool_blocked 0.65993790 and pool_encode_blocked 0.65995856 did not identify a timing advantage. Retain these unsuccessful click trajectories; they motivate attribution before adding capacity.

Current recent_occupied auxiliary AUC 0.712407/0.728685/0.671858 remains far below baseline-din 0.849070/0.864897/0.870182. Click selection is frozen; this proposal does not claim general four-task superiority or solve auxiliary gradient starvation.

Released whole-window vocabularies, static snapshots and official_offline delayed feedback remain inherited benchmark assumptions. Historical exposures are ads; auxiliary labels match user/category/brand within 24h and are not ad-specific conversion attribution.
